full_prompt_en: A square, intensely worked realist painting shows an elderly man in extreme close-up against a crowded dark workshop background. His gray hair, bald crown, lined brow, and thick beard fill almost the entire frame, with the chin cropped by the lower border. The head turns toward the right and slightly downward, so one heavy-lidded eye, a long nose, and the left ear are especially prominent. Deep creases run across the forehead and around the eye. Fine gray-white strands in the hair and beard are individually worked, merging with broader cool shadows as they move toward the bottom. The visible skin is pale, weathered, and warm around the ear and nose, but cool gray in the cheek shadow. Behind him, a dense accumulation of dark tools, metal rings, narrow pipes, and small irregular objects fills the right and upper edges. The background is too intricate to name every object, yet curved metal arcs and warm brass glints are clear near the right side. A narrow reddish vertical mark rises near the upper right. The man seems absorbed in thought rather than looking at the viewer; his mouth is mostly hidden by the beard and dark lower shadow. A restrained light from the upper left skims the scalp, forehead, ear, and beard, making wrinkles and individual hairs stand out while the workshop remains largely in brown-black shade. The painted surface is dense with short strokes, scratch-like marks, and layered color, even where the image looks almost photographic from a distance. The limited palette uses bone gray, ashen blue, dark umber, and tiny rusty gold accents. There is no readable text. The overall composition is intimate and uneasy, pressing finely observed age and physical texture against an almost overwhelming thicket of objects.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、刻画极其密集的写实绘画呈现一名老人的特写，身后是拥挤而昏暗的工作间。灰发、秃顶、布满皱纹的额头和浓密胡须几乎填满画面，下巴被下缘裁断。头朝右并略微低下，因此一只眼皮沉重的眼、长鼻子和左耳格外突出。深皱纹横过额头，绕着眼睛展开。灰白头发与胡须中的细丝被逐根刻画，越往下越融入较宽的冷影。可见肌肤浅而风化，耳朵与鼻子周围偏暖，脸颊阴影中则呈冷灰。身后密集堆积的深色工具、金属环、窄管和不规则小物件填满右侧与上方。背景繁杂得难以逐一命名，但右边附近的弯曲金属弧和温暖黄铜闪光清楚可见。右上附近升起一道狭窄红色竖痕。男子像沉浸在思绪里，没有望向观者；嘴被胡须和深色下部阴影大多挡住。来自左上方的克制光线掠过头皮、额头、耳朵与胡须，使皱纹和单根毛发凸显，工作间则大多留在棕黑影子中。画面表面布满短笔触、刮擦般痕迹和层叠颜色，即使远看几乎像照片也能看出绘画制作。有限配色使用骨灰、灰蓝、深赭棕和微小锈金色重音。没有可读文字。整体构图亲密而不安，把细致观察的衰老与身体肌理压在近乎令人窒息的物件丛中。
style_prompt_en: The densely rendered realist painting builds physical presence from countless short strokes, etched creases, and layered mottled color. Ash gray, cool blue-black, deep umber, and small rusty gold accents create a low-key palette that still contains many subtle temperature changes. A large near form receives grazing light, making ridges and fine surface strands visible; the surrounding field stays dark yet heavily articulated. Sharp focus is concentrated on a few tactile details, while intricate background marks intertwine and recede without becoming blank. Curved lines, small hard glints, and irregular clusters make the composition crowded at every edge. Deep shadow gives the lighted form volume, but the texture never becomes smooth or idealized. The overall effect is obsessive, somber, and tactile, with painstaking mark-making turning ordinary material wear into dramatic structure.
style_prompt_zh: 这种密集刻画的写实绘画通过无数短笔触、刻划般皱线和层叠斑驳颜色建立真实存在感。灰白、冷蓝黑、深赭棕及小块锈金重音构成低明度配色，内部仍有许多微妙冷暖变化。较大的近处形体接住擦过表面的光，使凸起纹路和细微表面丝线可见；周围色域保持黑暗，却依然刻画繁密。清晰焦点集中于少数可触细节，复杂背景痕迹互相缠绕并后退，却不变成空白。曲线、小而硬的亮点及不规则簇团让构图在每处边缘都显拥挤。深影赋予受光形体体积，但肌理从不平滑或理想化。整体效果执着、阴沉而可触，耐心密集的笔痕把普通材料磨损转为戏剧性结构。
theme_en: An elderly bearded man against an intricate dark workshop background
theme_zh: 繁密昏暗工作间前的长胡须老人
name: Ivan Albright
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
